checks.title: Employee missing an employee ID
checks.description: An acme:Employee individual has no acme:hasEmployeeId value -- every employee record must be traceable to Acme's HR system of record.
checks.remediation: Add acme:hasEmployeeId "ACM-NNNN" to the employee, or fix the triplify query/CSV mapping that should have set it.
checks.cucumber_scenario: Every employee record carries a traceable employee ID
